sys_remote_update_set.name: UAT_POC_Golden_Benchmark_Configuration_v1
sys_remote_update_set.description: Out-of-band configuration update set for Incident UAT benchmark (10 seeded config defects + 4 by-design decoys). Applied by an instance administrator prior to non-admin persona UAT execution.

u_seeded_rule.description: Override Impact=1 + Urgency=1 priority lookup to 4 (Low)
Route Category=network incidents to Software group
Make close_code optional when state changes to Resolved (6)
Permit direct transition from New (1) to Closed (7)
Allow non-itil requester role to read incident.work_notes
Redirect assignment notification recipient away from assigned group
Disable dependent-value filtering of subcategory by category
Remove pause condition when Incident state is On Hold (3)
Make short_description optional on New incident creation
Do not clear close_code/close_notes when reopening Resolved -> In Progress

u_decoy_rule.description: Requester cannot view work_notes while comments remain visible
Queue-based assignment policy across repeatable runs
